rootCauses: The container used runtime_os_acceptance_api (55 sessions), while 713 archived sessions remained in live_runtime_api.
Existing API and MCP host data bind mounts were already present; mounts alone did not migrate PostgreSQL indexes.
OpenSearch body reads were disabled although 1704 retained RocksDB records referenced external bodies.
The browser requested the legacy username while newer history used the same authenticated principal stable UUID.
Initial workspace manifest completion cleared a history selection made during startup; the chat change-only watcher also skipped an initial prop.
An empty header analysis tree prevented rebuilding analysis branches from persisted message metadata.

recovery.notes: Migration-count snapshots cover all stored owners/tenants. Subsequent unrelated user activity added two messages and one task. A single browser account sees only its authorized platform history. 117 bodies were reconstructed from stored single-turn responses with original identity and immutable key timestamps; no model inference was used.

publicApi.newDetailField: missingMessageCount: integer; zero when all indexed bodies were restored
publicApi.identityResolution: ObjectAccessService.ownerAliases; current authenticated tenant, UUID and verified legacy username only
publicApi.sourceChannels: PLATFORM_UI/null retained in sidebar; AGENT_API remains separate

frontendTests.scope: Vitest pure functions and actual mounted Vue lifecycle in jsdom

validation.postgresMigrationIdempotency: Eight tables repeated with zero inserts
validation.realServerAliases: 602 visible platform sessions; username and UUID queries identical; unauthorized principal receives 403; title search checked
validation.concurrentUserTurn: One observed session received an additional user turn during maintenance. Its original message IDs and new turn were preserved; other snapshot cases retained identical body/state hashes.
validation.waitedForExistingTask: The previously running task was allowed to become terminal (CANCELLED/KILLED) before container replacement. No cancellation was issued by this repair; its attempt stayed at one.
validation.realModelAcceptance: Not run or needed for history/storage repair; no model calls or analysis execution claimed
validation.fullBackendSuite: Not rerun for this increment. Prior repository baseline had 130 failures and 64 errors; this report does not claim a green full suite.

build.incrementalPackaging: R5 reused compiled Java classes from validated R4; only frontend source changed. Full R4 Maven packaging and the 24 focused Java tests passed; R5 resource packaging, frontend tests and artifact scans passed.

resolvedVerificationFailures: Offline repair rejected SQL/key time-zone mismatches before its atomic write; immutable key timestamps fixed it and the copy-based atomicity test verified zero partial writes.
A new negative permission test initially expected the wrong exception class; it now asserts the actual scope-denied exception and passes.
The local Nginx redirect test inherited a machine HTTP proxy; localhost requests now explicitly bypass proxies and all five Docker tests pass.
Real browser testing exposed both initial-prop and workspace-bootstrap selection races; actual mounted lifecycle, delayed-manifest isolation and final browser tests cover the fixes.
One Docker registry TLS timeout succeeded on retry using the same resolved base digest.
unresolved: 192 indexed message bodies are absent from retained RocksDB/OpenSearch. Some multi-turn event histories are ambiguous and are deliberately not guessed. Additional trustworthy backups are needed for full recovery.
Empty conversations with zero message indexes remain empty; no placeholder answer is fabricated.
Existing artifact expiration policies and permissions remain in force; restoring history does not recreate already expired/deleted artifact files.
After API replacement the acceptance login was refreshed; authentication-token survival was not claimed as part of chat-history persistence.

operations.rollback: Restore the reviewed private prior Compose/environment and API image, then recreate only API/node-proxy/gateway. Keep current persistent data, merged history and external body readers. Do not overwrite the live database with an old dump during image rollback.
